scripts.dev: npm run system:init && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run port:check && npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev:full: npm run system:init && concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.system:init: npm run system:kill-node && npm run port:check
scripts.system:kill-node: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Process -Name 'node' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Id -ne $PID } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue"
scripts.port:free-3000: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($proc) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force }"
scripts.port:free-3001: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($proc) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.OwningProcess -Force }"
